statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitoring study) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and sinus node dysfunction
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
